name: adsbeast
description: Work with your own ADS Beast advertising workspace: account audits, wasted spend, tracking and budget checks, platform comparison, leads with attribution, and campaign changes that run only from a stored preview and wait for a person's approval. Twelve workflow skills. Requires an ADS Beast account and a scoped API key.

ADSBEAST_API_KEY.description: A scoped key from ADS Beast under API Keys, starting with absk_. An admin creates it.
